description: The generated woman wears an opaque cream floor-length square-necked gown with fitted bodice seams and sleeves to the elbows. Rust-red, brown and muted gold geometric woven bands border the neckline, vertical central panel and hem. A rust-brown patterned shawl with gold borders loops around both elbows and falls down either side. A rust and gold sash belt closes with a round textured metal medallion and hanging fabric ends. Small gold drop earrings, a circular pendant necklace and gold bracelets are visible; pointed brown-gold shoes emerge under the hem. Woven textile has irregular folds and subdued sheen rather than rigid plate surfaces.
